description: A one-hour signed-in link to the payment provider's billing page for a card subscription, where the customer changes the card that is charged or downloads receipts. The link is for the human to open in a browser — do not fetch it. A lease paid once or by bank transfer has no card on file, and the call says so.

access_token.description: Returned by order_lease. The only credential for a lease.

name: billing_portal_link
